instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor conducting a reassessment. Analyse the prior assessment summary, changes since last assessment, and updated survey, then respond with a complete reassessment JSON including score_delta, carry_forward, progress, and comparison_to_previous.

answers.companyDescription: Higher education institution with 8,000 students across undergraduate and master's programs in business, engineering, and health sciences. Developing hybrid learning capabilities and micro-credential programs for executive education. Key challenge is student retention analytics and personalized learning pathway design. We operate across multiple geographies and business units with a matrix organizational structure. A centralized digital transformation office coordinates innovation initiatives, but business unit autonomy means adoption varies significantly. Annual capex budget for innovation exists but deployment is gated by rigorous ROI modeling and steering committee approval.
answers.pastInitiatives: We launched a digital customer onboarding flow last quarter that reduced average onboarding time from 12 days to 5 days. The project was cross-functional involving product, compliance, and customer success teams. Early NPS scores for new customers onboarded through this flow are 22 points higher than the legacy process.
answers.strategicGoals: Growth is our existential mandate. We are losing market share to faster-moving competitors and need to reignite our growth trajectory. We are willing to make significant strategic bets — potentially including M&A, new product lines, or geographic expansion — provided they have a credible path to meaningful revenue contribution within 18 months.
answers.teamSize: Innovation is decentralized across business units, each with its own innovation lead and dedicated resources, coordinated by a group-level Chief Innovation Officer. The total innovation workforce is approximately 100 people across the organization. A group innovation fund of €5M annually is allocated competitively — business units pitch for funding against clear innovation KPIs including revenue from new products and process efficiency gains.

input.changes_since_last: Supply chain disruptions affected 6 product lines. Inventory digitalization project launched. Margins under pressure.

opportunities.title: Scale Digital Customer Experience Blueprint Across All Verticals
opportunities.rationale: The success of the digital onboarding flow proves the concept. This opportunity involves raising the blueprint into an enterprise standard, ensuring that all business units adopt best practices and mitigating variability caused by matrix structure.

first_actions: Establish a cross-BU 'Digital Experience Governance Board' to standardize process ownership.
Map 3 core student/executive journeys (e.g., enrollment, module access, graduation) and identify common pain points.
Integrate compliance requirements for data consent and privacy into the standard digital workflow templates.
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in average time-to-value for a new student journey by 20% within 12 months.
milestones: Standardized Blueprint Drafted and Tested on Pilot BU

opportunities.title: Form a Dedicated Growth Acceleration Unit (GAU) for Market Bets
opportunities.rationale: To counteract market share loss and capitalize on the 'growth' mandate, Fusion needs dedicated structure for strategic bets. This unit must operate independently of existing BU funding cycles to pursue M&A or entirely new product lines.

first_actions: Form a small, highly empowered cross-functional team ('Tiger Team') with representation from Finance, Strategy, and Tech.
Develop a standardized 'Deal Thesis' framework that defines criteria for M&A targets or new markets (e.g., immediate revenue pathway, regulatory fit).
Identify 3 potential strategic partnerships or small-to-midsize acquisition candidates within the target sectors.
execution_plan.success_metric: Completion of initial due diligence and scoring of at least 5 viable external opportunities within six months.
milestones: GAU Charter Signed Off by Executive Leadership
First Investment Recommendation Presented to Board

next_steps.action: Mandate the adoption of standardized performance indicators (KPIs) for student retention and module completion across all BUs to measure success consistently.
Convene the core leadership group for the Growth Acceleration Unit (GAU) to finalize scope, secure funding access, and formalize the governance charter.
Conduct a detailed audit of current talent capabilities against the needs of predictive analytics and advanced data modeling, identifying critical external hires or training paths.

key_weaknesses: Decentralized adoption model leading to inconsistent process implementation across BUs.
High reliance on siloed, manual ROI modeling for funding approval, slowing strategic speed.
Lack of a centralized, predictive data platform capable of identifying students at high risk of attrition proactively.

improvements: Successfully launched the digital customer onboarding flow, significantly improving early student experience and NPS scores.
Inventory digitalization project has begun, addressing supply chain vulnerability for multiple product lines.
Increased internal understanding of process efficiency gains through measurable pre/post-project comparison.
persistent_gaps: The ability to translate successful pilot initiatives into mandatory, scalable enterprise standards remains challenged by BUs' autonomy.
Strategic funding for new growth vectors (M&A, major product lines) requires a governance model faster than the current committee review cycle.
achieved_milestones: Digital Customer Onboarding Flow successfully deployed and measured against pre-launch metrics.
Initial scope defined for Inventory Digitalization Project across target geographies.

comparison_to_previous.key_changes: Increased momentum due to demonstrable wins (onboarding flow) and a clear strategic mandate for growth. The shift from process optimization to actively seeking external market bets elevates the potential maturity score.
